question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"improve"** means to make or become better; to enhance the quality or condition of something. (सुधारना)

 
 
• **Example: **Regular practice can significantly improve your performance in any skill.
 
 
 
• **"Improve" **is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5 as it aligns with the context of making something better or enhancing it. (सुधारना)
 
 
• **Example: **To improve the efficiency of the process, we need to automate certain tasks.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that whether your goal is to communicate better with your partner, children, etc., developing these abilities can strengthen your bonds with people, foster greater mutual respect and trust, and enhance problem-solving, teamwork, and your general mental and social well-being.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **improve.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hamper **(बाधा डालना): To hinder or impede the movement or progress of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The heavy rain will hamper our plans for a picnic.
 
 
 
• **Hasten **(शीघ्र करना): To cause something to happen sooner than it otherwise would.
 
 
• **Example: **Measures were taken to hasten the recovery process.
 
 
 
• **Disturb** (व्यवधान डालना): To interrupt the normal arrangement or functioning of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Loud noises from the construction site disturb my concentration.
